svg.aria-label: Three clusters in 50 dimensions: PCA shows one tight, one wide and one far-away cluster; t-SNE makes the clusters similar in size and shrinks the large gap; t-SNE of plain 2-D Gaussian noise at perplexity 2 shows clumps that are not real
